title: English for Exams: Essays & Speaking
description: Prepare specifically for B2-level English exams (such as Cambridge B2 First or IELTS Band 5.5–6.5): essay writing techniques, speaking exam strategies, task response, and timed practice. Suitable for learners preparing for internationally recognised English qualifications.

content.content: {"time":1700100001000,"blocks":[{"id":"oA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"An opinion essay requires you to state and develop a clear position with supporting arguments and a balanced conclusion. In B2 exams, you typically have 140–190 words."}},{"id":"oD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Essay Structure","level":3}},{"id":"oG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Introduction: state the topic and your position (2–3 sentences)","Body paragraph 1: first supporting argument + example","Body paragraph 2: second supporting argument + example (or counterargument + refutation)","Conclusion: restate your position and give a final thought"]}},{"id":"oJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Key Phrases for an Opinion Essay","level":3}},{"id":"oM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["In my view, / It is my firm belief that... [introducing opinion]","Furthermore, / In addition, / What is more,... [adding a point]","While some might argue that... I believe... [concede + refute]","In conclusion, / To sum up,... [closing]"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: In my ___, social media has more negative than positive effects on young people. ___ more, research consistently shows that heavy use is linked to anxiety. While ___ might argue that it helps people stay connected, I believe the risks outweigh the benefits. In ___, action is needed to regulate how these platforms target teenagers.

questions.text: In an exam essay, what should you do in the conclusion?
options: Restate your position and give a final thought
Write as many words as possible

questions.text: Which phrase is best for adding a second supporting point in an essay?

content.content: {"time":1700100002000,"blocks":[{"id":"lA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A formal letter or email is a common exam writing task. You need to use the correct format, formal register, and appropriate content."}},{"id":"lD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Formal Letter/Email Conventions","level":3}},{"id":"lG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Begin with Dear Sir/Madam (if unknown) or Dear Mr/Ms [Surname]","State your purpose clearly in the first paragraph","Use formal vocabulary (avoid contractions like don't; use do not)","Sign off with Yours faithfully (if unknown) or Yours sincerely"]}},{"id":"lJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Common Exam Letter Tasks","level":3}},{"id":"lM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Letter of complaint","Letter of application","Letter requesting information","Letter of recommendation"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

lessons.title: Performing Well in the Speaking Exam

content.content: {"time":1700100003000,"blocks":[{"id":"spA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"In B2 speaking exams, you are assessed on fluency, vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation — not just on the accuracy of your information. Here are strategies for each part."}},{"id":"spD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Part 1: Personal Questions","level":3}},{"id":"spG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Expand your answers — never give a one-word reply","Use 'and', 'also', 'because', 'which means' to extend","Example: 'Do you like sport?' → 'Yes, I play tennis twice a week, mainly because I find it relaxing and it keeps me fit.'"]}},{"id":"spJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Part 2: Long Turn (1–2 minutes on a photo/topic)","level":3}},{"id":"spM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Structure your answer: describe → speculate → evaluate","Useful phrases: 'It seems to me that...' / 'I'd imagine that...' / 'On the other hand...'","Fill silences: 'What I find particularly interesting is...' / 'Another thing to consider is...'"]}},{"id":"spN1oP2qQ3r","type":"header","data":{"text":"Pronunciation Tips","level":3}},{"id":"spO2pP3qQ4r","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Stress key words in sentences","Pause after commas and full stops","Link words naturally: 'a lot of' sounds like 'alotta'","Don't rush — clarity is more important than speed"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I'd imagine that the people in this photo are on a business trip, mainly because they're wearing formal clothes and seem to be discussing something important. On the other hand, it could be a training day or a conference.

questions.text: In the speaking exam, you are asked 'Do you prefer books or films?' You say 'Films.' What should you do?
options: Add reasons and examples to expand your answer
Ask the examiner to repeat the question

questions.text: Which phrase is useful to speculate about a photo in the speaking exam?
options: I don't know what this is.

lessons.title: Managing Time and Avoiding Common Mistakes

content.content: {"time":1700100004000,"blocks":[{"id":"stA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Good exam technique can make a significant difference to your score. Here are the most important strategies."}},{"id":"stD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Time Management","level":3}},{"id":"stG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Read the question carefully before you write anything","Plan your essay in 2–3 minutes before starting","Keep track of time — don't spend too long on one section","Leave 3 minutes to proofread at the end"]}},{"id":"stJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Common Mistakes to Avoid","level":3}},{"id":"stM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Writing too little or too much (stay within the word limit)","Not answering all parts of the question","Using informal language in formal writing tasks","Repeating the same vocabulary — use synonyms!","Forgetting to check subject-verb agreement and tenses"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

questions.text: Before starting to write your essay in an exam, what should you do first?
options: Read the question carefully and plan your answer

questions.text: Why should you use synonyms in a writing exam?
options: To demonstrate vocabulary range and avoid repetition
